messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered — PD-INC-1718204322 — service=hotpath-runtime. symptom=p99 latency 1.2s (SLO=500ms). source=frontend-proxy/hotpath-prod. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-1718204322

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: PD-INC-1718204322 — escalation policy: hotpath-sev2. pager acknowledged by Maria (SRE).

Maria (SRE): acked in PD. I'm on it — quick triage starting. pulling grafana & logs for hotpath. no deploys in last 2h.

Devon: confirming spike on grafana (https://grafana.company/r/dash). p95 rising too, p99 worst in EU-west.

Maria (SRE): looks EU-west only. p99 from 1200ms, p95 around 300-400ms. request rate steady.

Aj: can we shift a portion of traffic off hotpath to fallback-compact? suggest 10% traffic -> fallback variant to reduce load.

Natasha: starting traffic shift: router rule applied: route hotpath-prod -> fallback-compact (10%). watching for errors.

Maria (SRE): also scaling hotpath-runtime replicas up. running:
```
kubectl -n production scale deployment hotpath-runtime --replicas=6
```

Devon: logs show a pattern — KV cache evictions spike + repeated full-attention runs on some sessions. pods hotpath-2 and hotpath-5 show repeated GC churn. attaching excerpt.

Aj: disabling batching temporarily to try reduce latency tail. patch applied (BATCH_WINDOW_MS=0).

Maria (SRE): monitoring after scale+shift+batch-off. if no improvement in 2min, we escalate for GPU migration or model fallback.

pagerduty: Reminder — infra escalation scheduled in 5m if alert still firing.

infra-oncall: on it. can you paste affected pod names and collect metrics snapshots (`/metrics` + `/proc`)? will analyze kernel/cgroup signals.

Maria (SRE): pods with most evictions: hotpath-2, hotpath-5, hotpath-6. collecting `curl http://localhost:9100/metrics` and `kubectl top pod` now.

Devon: also seeing surge of long sequence lengths from a small client IP range. querying request logs for malformed streams.

Aj: enabled prefix caching for stable prefixes to reduce recompute on repeated prefixes.

Maria (SRE): p99 dropped from 1.2s -> ~680ms after scale + traffic shift + batch off :thumbsup:. still above SLO but trending down.

Natasha: propose model fallback to quantized variant (xform-q8). quality tradeoff minimal for these routes; latency gain expected ~40%. canary 20%?

Devon: starting canary: route 20% of fallback-> model-x-q8. initial canary p99=420ms. no increased error rate observed.

Maria (SRE): good. widen to 60% fallback canary now.

pagerduty: note added to PD: severity set to SEV2 — customer-facing latency impact acknowledged.

Maria (SRE): preparing handoff at +30m. @Natasha will take on-call. I'll write the initial incident notes.

Natasha: taking over — current status: p99 stabilized ~450ms at 60% quantized fallback; scale replicas=6 in effect; router continues partial traffic shift. will monitor closely and update every 10 minutes.

Devon: opening follow-up ticket: HOTPATH-456 — investigate KV eviction root cause, hot key patterns, and batching interaction. will include logs and heatmap.

Maria (SRE): notes added to incident doc: https://confluence.company/incidents/INC-1718204322 — will own postmortem.

Natasha: running extended checks for hot keys and scheduler backpressure. also verifying autoscaler thresholds for sudden queue growth.

incident-bot: Incident auto-close preflight: no alerts for 30m will trigger auto-close.

Natasha: ack — leaving channel open. I will post updates or escalate if regressions.

Maria (SRE): thanks team. leaving channel.

Natasha: 10m status update: p99 holding ~430-470ms. no new evictions after scale + fallback. continuing monitoring.
